name: Koh Talabeng and sunset by private longtail

seo.title: Koh Talabeng & Sunset by Longtail | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: An afternoon on your own longtail: the Koh Lanta mangrove, sea caves and a swim at Koh Talabeng, then a meal at sunset off Koh Por. 7,000 THB for 1 to 4.

h1: Your own longtail for the afternoon, from the mangrove to the sunset at Koh Por
lead: The Thung Yee Peng mangrove, the view from Koh Ung, a kayak into the sea caves of Koh Talabeng and a swim from a small beach. Then a meal while the sun goes down at Koh Por, with only your group on board.
promise: Mangrove, sea caves, a swim and a sunset meal

facts.label: Where
facts.value: Thung Yee Peng, east coast of Koh Lanta

facts.label: Village entrance fee
facts.value: 40 THB per adult, 20 THB per child from 4 to 11, not included

options.label: Private longtail, mangrove, Koh Talabeng and sunset at Koh Por
options.note: The price covers the boat for 1 to 4 people. Each extra adult adds 1,400 THB and each extra child from 4 to 11 adds 700 THB, so 5 adults pay 8,400 THB. Children under 4 come free.

day.title: The afternoon on the longtail
day.note: The route depends on the weather and the sea on the day.

steps.text: Pickup at your hotel and the drive to Thung Yee Peng community pier.
Into the mangrove forest by longtail. Look out for long-tailed macaques and the local birds.
A stop at Koh Ung for the view all around, over the islands and the sea.
Koh Talabeng: kayak along the coast, into the sea caves and past the limestone rocks, then time on a small beach to rest and swim.
Sunset at Koh Por, with a meal while the sun goes down over the sea.

included: Pickup and drop-off at your hotel
The longtail for your group only

beforeYouBook.children: The longtail is for your group only. Children under 4 come free. Beyond the first four people, children from 4 to 11 pay 700 THB instead of 1,400 THB.
beforeYouBook.weather: The route depends on the weather and the sea on the day.

faq.q: How much for a bigger group?
faq.a: 7,000 THB covers the boat for up to 4 people. Each extra adult adds 1,400 THB and each extra child from 4 to 11 adds 700 THB. Children under 4 come free.
Yes. After the kayak at Koh Talabeng there is time on a small beach to rest and swim.

faq.q: How is it different from the plankton trip?
faq.a: This one is an afternoon of islands, sea caves and a swim, with a meal at sunset and back at your hotel by 18:30. The plankton trip starts at 16:30, with a barbecue at sunset and a kayak in the dark.

faq.q: Is the village entrance fee included?
faq.a: No. Thung Yee Peng village charges 40 THB per adult and 20 THB per child from 4 to 11, paid on the spot.

photos.alt: Two guests sharing a meal and fresh fruit on the bow of a longtail at sunset
photos.shot: Guests eating on the longtail bow at sunset.
